verdict.rationale: Canny documents its own official JavaScript SDK, used to identify users and tie their feedback to existing accounts. Its developer docs also cover web and mobile widget embedding and an API reference. The SDK's scope appears narrow (identify and widget), and no multi-language or server-side SDKs are evidenced. Missing for 10: server-side or multi-language official SDKs, SDK coverage of the full API, any published OpenAPI spec (all probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
